about: The fixed subset of ARCHITECTURE.md 6.9 item 1: these 30 programs of the tracked sets are assembled by the official EDIT68K.exe v5.16.1 with each of the eight assembler options switched alone from its shipped value (the labels of SINGLE_OPTION_SETS in tests/oracle/wine/asm/settings.ts), besides their other runs; tests/oracle/wine/asm/regenerate.mjs plans those runs from this list and the conformance tests compare every one of them with the port. Nothing of the site set is here (it may not be redistributed). Chosen so that each option changes the output of several of them; why each one is here: docs/porting/errata/T1.md entry 20.
